text:
maya: Lumina wants a 9mo amendment + 10 Accelerator seats. They prefer PO/net30 but are ok with CC fallback to avoid provisioning delay. Can procurement + legal confirm the path? cc @kevin-renewals @eli-legal @james-procure :wave:

kevin-renewals: i can draft the amendment. propose clause: PO required, but if not received within 7 business days, we charge card on file. who are the signers?

maya: Linda M. (CFO) and Sam P. (Procurement). customer hopes to close this week but PO may take longer.

james-procure: we need vendor code & remit entity. if VC exists we can get PO in ~48-72h, otherwise longer. ask customer to email PO to procurement@redwood.com with vendor code to expedite.

sara-ops: ops note: CC allows immediate provisioning. PO + wire requires invoice entity + vendor code; also confirm KMS requirement before provisioning.

eli-legal: legal flags: term shortening is a material amendment. draft must include prorate math, payment fallback, and KMS/data residency confirmation. standard review ~24h. wet-sign only if Docusign fails.

kevin-renewals: drafting now, will add PO field & fallback language. i'll hold the envelope until we get vendor code or CSM confirms CC fallback.

docusign-bot: Envelope queued (env_0xLUM123). Status: draft.

maya: thanks. i'll nudge Lumina for vendor code and ask them to email procurement. i'll update the CSM playbook and set a 48h follow-up.

sara-ops: ops checklist added: 1) confirm vendor code/entity 2) legal sign-off 3) PO or CC confirmed 4) send envelope 5) invoice & provision post-signature/payment.

maya: will update thread with PO or CC confirmation. :thumbsup:
